therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Cetuximab + Docetaxel + Low Dose Fractionated Radiation
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: EGFR inhibition combined with microtubule stabilization and DNA damage
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation inhibition and enhanced radiosensitivity
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: recurrent squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck

results.effect_size: 50% ORR at 1 month, 0% ORR at 6 months
results.dose_information: Cetuximab: 400 mg/m2 loading dose, then 250 mg/m2 weekly; Docetaxel: 20 mg/m2 IV weekly; Radiation: 0.5 Gy BID for total 12 Gy
